name: Mastek Ltd
title: Mastek Ltd - 523704 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Mastek Q4 FY26 was stable: revenue up 3.6% QoQ in INR, EBITDA 16.1%, 12-month backlog $300.4M (+13.5% YoY USD), but management gave no numeric FY27 growth guidance and flagged heavy renewal price cuts.

utilisation.quote: Utilization rate improved during Q4 at 80%, which was an improvement of 3.3% from Q3 and 1.7% from Q2.

triggers.label: Renewal discounts 10-15%, possibly higher
triggers.quote: we had renewed some of our contracts with anywhere around 10% to 15% discount. But depending on the nature of business and the nature of customers, it could go much higher than that

triggers.label: 12-month backlog $300.4M, +13.5% YoY
triggers.quote: We closed the year with 12-month backlog of $300.4 million, a sequential growth of 1.5% and a Y-o-Y growth of 13.5% in USD

triggers.label: Utilisation 80% in Q4
triggers.quote: Utilization rate improved during Q4 at 80%, which was an improvement of 3.3% from Q3
triggers.highlight: Utilization rate improved during Q4 at 80%

triggers.label: No numeric FY27 growth guidance
triggers.quote: So usually, we don't give guidance on future numbers. Having said that, we believe it will be a better performance than the previous year.
triggers.highlight: we don't give guidance on future numbers

triggers.label: North America margin down on wage hike
triggers.quote: on North America, it's mostly the pressure of the revenue still stabilizing as well as the impact of the wage hike
triggers.highlight: pressure of the revenue still stabilizing

guidance.quote: maintaining margin percentage for the coming period at 16% -16.1% is where we see the margin performances
we believe it will be a better performance than the previous year
Going forward, our average effective tax rate would be 24.5% to 24.7%.

red_flags.label: Renewal price cuts 10-15%+
red_flags.quote: The renewals clearly are being extremely price competitive.

red_flags.label: Labor Code exceptional charge INR23.7 cr
red_flags.quote: we recognized an exceptional and incremental impact of INR23.7 crores, which includes gratuity of INR16 crores

red_flags.label: Q3 EBITDA restated 16.1% to 16.8%
red_flags.quote: The Q3 EBITDA has improved from 16.1% to 16.8%.

red_flags.label: Wartime AMEA revenue pulled from Q2
red_flags.quote: it was around $0.5 million worth of WAR revenue that we were able to recognize that we had postponed in Q2

evasions.quote: So usually, we don't give guidance on future numbers.
the 12 -month order backlog has not increased significantly
